title: Partnering With Front
snippet:
Front’s partnership program allows third-party developers to launch integrations that can be easily installed by any Front customer. At Front, our mission is to be the hub for customer communication and customer operations, and our partnerships with developers like yourself are at the heart of that mission. You can see dozens of our existing partners in our [Integrations Directory](https://front.com/integrations).

As a Front partner, you’ll receive the following benefits:
- Access to thousands of highly engaged businesses already using Front
- Marketing exposure through our Integrations page
- First notice about upcoming improvements and new API features by joining our [community](https://community.front.com/api-news-updates-40)

###
1. Build your integration
Depending on the type of integration you are trying to build, you’ll want to check out the documentation for either the Core API, Plugin SDK, or Channels API. Depending on your integration, you may need to take advantage of more than one of these APIs.
If your integration is backend-oriented and needs to make CRUD operations to data in Front, check out the [Core API](https://dev.frontapp.com/docs/core-api-overview).
> 📘
>
> ###
> Integrations that use the Core API are required to use OAuth
>
>
>
> In order to simplify customer configuration steps and to easily maintain your app when new Front features are released, we require that partner integrations connect to the Core API via [OAuth](https://dev.frontapp.com/docs/oauth) unless you obtain an exception from us. The only exceptions we currently consider are ones where you cannot access certain Front resources via OAuth.

title: Rate limits
snippet:
Rate limits for the integrations you use / Partner rate limits
Note that API requests made by a partner integration on behalf of a company via OAuth have a separate rate limit of 120 rpm (enforced on a per-company basis). This means that API requests made by integrations installed by a customer do not count against the customer’s rate limit (the only exception to this is the Zapier integration).

title: Welcome
snippet:
Step 2: Partnering with Front
If you’re looking to partner with Front to launch a public integration to all Front customers, please see our guide to [Partnering with Front](https://dev.frontapp.com/docs/partnering-with-front). You can see what some of our other partners have already built at our [Integrations page](https://frontapp.com/integrations).
If you are building an integration meant only for your own company or for one client, you can skip learning about the partnership process.

title: Front Integration Partner Program
snippet:
## Front Integration Partner benefits
Partners receive exclusive access to incentives, resources, and support.
##### Standard
###### Tech & product benefits
- Free sandbox developer account
- Technical support
###### Marketing benefits
- Considered for select marketing activities
- Listed on Front’s integration marketplace
- Right to use the Front brand assets
##### Plus
Front’s plus tier offers the standard benefits plus the ones listed below. Inclusion in this tier is by invitation only.
###### Tech & product benefits
- Premium technical support
- Product demo led by Front product specialist
- Previews into Platform & API roadmap
###### Marketing benefits
- Two-way lead sharing
- Eligible for various co-marketing activities
- Select account mapping and co-selling opportunities

title: API tokens
snippet:
OAuth access versus API tokens
Front requires that partners implement OAuth instead of API tokens when building Core API integrations that make updates on behalf of a Front customer or their account, unless you obtain an exception from us. OAuth makes it easier for users to enable and use your integration by allowing users to simply authorize the app with an existing account. To learn more about this topic, refer to [Authentication](/docs/authentication).
To learn how to configure OAuth, refer to the [Create, manage, and publish apps](/docs/create-and-manage-apps) topic.

- **Auto-provisioning** allows you to manage provisioning resources using our SCIM implementation, which you have to contact our team to learn more about (not generally available to the public).

title: Front Partner Program | SaaS Channel Partner
snippet:
# Turn customer operations into your next growth lever
With the Front Partner Program, get the incentives, resources, and support to grow your business and help clients run customer operations with confidence.

Why partner with Front?
### Expand your services
Grow your suite of offerings with a differentiated customer operations platform.
### Tap into unmatched TSD access
Work with Front through the TSD relationships your business already uses and trusts.
### Drive new business
Refer Front to your customer base and earn commissions that grow your business.
### Access dedicated resources
Get comprehensive training, technical support, and co-marketing opportunities to develop your technology portfolio.
### Unlock tech & product benefits
Receive priority support, a free Front account, and customized product demos to help you sell with confidence.
### Grow through marketing support
Use co-marketing, lead sharing, and industry insights to strengthen customer conversations.

Step 1
Submit the partner onboarding form through the Front Partner Portal.
Step 2
Your dedicated channel manager will reach out to schedule an intro call and set-up your account in the portal.
